comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
With Summer Triangle Update, the Epic Biography for Vasco da Gama will allow you to uncap Sail Handling from 20 -> 21.

I am temporarily posting this guide here:

Walkthrough
Chapter 1 "Beyond the Cape of Good Hope"
Lisbon → Talk to Gama at sea in Canary, Open Sea (15274,3848 - Straight southwest from Las Palmas).

*If you are following an admiral, you will be released from following when you enter the waters off the coast of the Canaries or when you talk to Gama.

→ (30 days of sailing required) Cape Verde → (90 days of sailing required) Natal

Chapter 2 "The Deadly Sickness"

Natal (Shipwright) → Mozambique → Mombasa → Malindi → Talk to Gama at sea at India, West coast (3367,4333).
*If you are following the admiral, the follow-up will be canceled when you enter the waters off the west coast of India or when you talk to Gama.

Chapter 3 "Prosperous City"
Calicut - In front of the Viceroy's audience room → (5 days of sailing required) In front of the Viceroy's audience room → South mansion → (60 days of sailing required) South mansion → Trading post district port → Combat immediately after leaving Calicut Enemy:
Armed merchant fleet (Arabian galleys *5): Use horizontal shooting skills and repairs
Friendly force: Gama fleet *3: Use evasion, ballistics, surgery and repair skills
*As with quests, vigilance skills (Caution, High Lookout) are disabled, retreat is possible, truce agreement and tributes are valid, combat can be avoided by entrusted sailing, but it will not progress. Amulet of the Sun, Tortoiseshell Charm and NPC reinforcement from Letter of Approval can be used to progress.

Chapter 4: "A Painful Return"
Malindi → (60 days of sailing) → West coast of Africa → Cape Verde → Azores

Rewards:

Chapter 1 - Beyond the Cape of Good Hope | Wind King Pendant (no-trade) x3
Chapter 2 - Deadly Disease | Tribute Goods for Brigands x3
Chapter 3 - A thriving city | Fisherman's Snacks x5
Chapter 4- A heartbreaking return | Precision Compass

Precision Compass stats:
Accessory
Sail Handling +3
Navigation +2
Formality: 15
Durability: 200
Fame to equip: 10000
